body: 20:56: Lane 9 (phone-settings) ok, landed f48b60dc. Lane 10 (shell-a11y) is the last wave 1 Lane and is running.U+000AU+000AU+002D Lane 9 breaks two existing tests outside its write-set (handoff lane-9.md).U+000A  U+002D test/app/app_shell_test.dart Android gear case. Fixed in the fix-up: `_expectLoadedSettingsScreen` takes `heading` (default 'Settings'), and the Android case passes 'preferences'. All 11 tests pass. Committed in the scratch worktree as d77ad5f3, after I rebased the earlier three fix-up commits onto f48b60dc (now 0c097c58, 46ce201b, 298c2666).U+000A  U+002D test/accessibility/fixes/settings_fixes_test.dart 'the disabled sync fields are named and marked disabled' is in Lane 10's write-set, so Lane 10 may fix it. If not, add `variant: TargetPlatformVariant.only(TargetPlatform.macOS)` and import flutter/foundation.dart.U+000AU+000AWave 2 audit against the built shell branch (risk 01M3ZHS8EE5C9YKF40264H5KBS). I extracted 79 code identifiers from wave2.items.json and git-grepped them on lib and test at the fix-up head. 23 were absent, and every one is either created by a wave 2 Step or is prototype JavaScript or prose:U+000AU+002D created in wave 2: MeadowFocus, MeadowTimeOfDay, OnboardingSwipeLayer, NoSwipe, RootArt (onboarding-roots), onboardingTitleTop (onboarding-frame), VoiceWaveform, openOtherWays, closeOtherWays, showingOtherWays, rootsForU+000AU+002D prototype JavaScript or prose: OpenGL, encodeURIComponent, flatMap, forceUpdate, linearGradient, onIter, petalImg, petalLook, petalVm, toFixed, xMidYMin, pathLengthU+000AU+000AInterfaces checked by shape:U+000AU+002D GlassTone has paper, scene and toast.U+000AU+002D StreakPill takes count, numberOnly and highlighted.U+000AU+002D PhoneBottomBar takes destinations, selected, optional onSelect and onCapture, and overScene, so a null onSelect gives the tour's non-interactive replica.U+000AU+000AThe fix-up overlaps two wave 2 write-sets, both compatible:U+000AU+002D onboarding-frame owns onboarding_finish_test. Its task changes navigation (swipe instead of onboardingPrimaryKey); my fix-up changed how the mood is read.U+000AU+002D petal-pace owns petal_layer_test. Its task changes the narrow-petal count; my fix-up limited the ShellContent check to the sidebar layout.U+000AU+000AWave 2 Workers inherit both because wave 2 branches from mitosis/proto-phone-shell. The fix-up must be cherry-picked onto that branch before `run.zsh 2`. No wave 2 item needs changing, and Lane 10 touches tests only, so the interfaces are final.
